# ShrinkMyPhoto

> Compress images to exact file size limits (20KB, 50KB, 100KB) on-device.

## Overview
ShrinkMyPhoto is an official zero-cookie, client-side utility in the OTHRYS Sovereign Fleet.
It executes entirely inside the user's browser via native Web APIs, WebCrypto, and WebAssembly.

- **Canonical URL:** https://shrinkmyphoto.othrys.be/
- **Category:** Images & Assets
- **Architecture:** 100% Client-Side In-Memory Execution
- **Privacy-First Analytics:** Zero cookies, zero third-party trackers, no IP addresses stored. Uses only first-party cookieless page-view counts (stats.othrys.be, 90-day expiry) that honor Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control.
- **Offline Mode:** Fully functional offline Progressive Web App (PWA).


## Core Capabilities
- Instant execution with sub-millisecond local latency.
- Confidential enterprise compliance: proprietary data, code, or tokens never cross the network.
- Sovereign Fleet Spotlight: Type `Cmd+K` or `/` in-app to quickly jump to any sister utility.
